notes: Christ Hospital grounds between Main (west) and Auburn Avenue (east). Main is printed 'MAIN' with 25' on the unopened strip at the top and 50' on the opened part (same jog as sheet 181 y 2805). Valencia (pipe, lines y 447/588) and 'TACOMA' (= Justis Street, lines y 1284/1422) are stubs from sheet 181 meeting Main from the west; T points on the 25 ft strip centre. 'ERIE (FEDERAL) (NOT OPENED)', 40', runs east from Main to Auburn Terrace; named Erie Street to match sheet 181 ('ERIE'). Auburn Terrace (printed 'AUBURN TERRACE (SYCAMORE)', on a pasted correction) starts at Erie's north line, and its west line is drawn solid across Erie's east end, so the Erie/Auburn Terrace point is really an L-corner (recorded as T) where the two centrelines meet. South of Mason Auburn Terrace is printed '(NOT IMPROVED)' 25'; its lines continue south of Huntington Place to the bottom edge, so Huntington is a crossing. 'ALLEY (NOT OPENED)', ~15 ft, runs from a lot line at x 1344 east to Auburn Terrace (listed under alleys). Mason ('MASON', 50' at Main, 47' at Auburn; 6 in. pipe) runs from Main to Auburn Avenue and ends at Auburn's west side; west of Main the unopened Mason diagonal (from sheet 181) comes in from the NW. The diagonal's centreline meets Main's centreline at y ~3297 and the east arm's centreline at y ~3354; the crossing is placed between them. Calumet (~43 ft, labelled 'CALUMET') comes in from the SW and meets the Mason diagonal just west of Main (same as sheet 181). The ~16 ft unnamed alley leaving Main's west side SW at y ~3870-3946 is the 'ALLEY' (15') of sheet 171 that runs south from Main across Gage; T end placed where its centreline extended meets Main's centreline. Huntington Place ('HUNTINGTON PL.', 50' at Main, 53' at Auburn, 4 in. pipe) runs Main to Auburn. McGrew ('Mc GREW') comes in from the SW at the bottom-left; only its NW side (corner at 546,4425) is drawn before the bottom edge, so its T point is placed from sheet 171's geometry (McGrew 50 ft there). Auburn Avenue ('AUBURN AV.', 60', three pipes) runs down the east side; Albion Place ('4" W.P. ALBION PL.', lines y 319/440), Gilman ('GILMAN', lines y 846/1015), 'SUPERIOR' (lines y 2167/2315) and 'SOUTHERN' (lines y 2931/3059) are stubs meeting Auburn from the east. Gilman named Gilman Avenue and SUPERIOR named Earnshaw Avenue from sheet 183 ('GILMAN AV.', 'EARNSHAW AV. (SUPERIOR AV.)'); SOUTHERN named Southern Avenue from sheet 173 ('SOUTHERN AV.'). The Christ Hospital 'PRIVATE DRIVE' (two, 18') and 'PARKWAY' that leave Auburn's west side at y ~1520-1760 are private hospital drives, not listed as streets.
